_comment: Locators: where in the app's code a question to the owner is about, found by the names in it and never judged (backlog 0487, ADR-022). A locator makes no finding and credits nothing; crates/sv-check/src/locate.rs says why, and data/README.md lists the fields.

locators.finds: functions whose names say they check a role or a permission, where they are written and where they are used

queries.javascript:
[(function_declaration name: (identifier) @defined)
 (method_definition name: (property_identifier) @defined)
 (variable_declarator name: (identifier) @defined value: [(arrow_function) (function_expression)])
 (call_expression function: (identifier) @used)
 (call_expression function: (member_expression property: (property_identifier) @used))
 (arguments (identifier) @used)
 (arguments (member_expression property: (property_identifier) @used))]
